Hidden Level develops RF sensing technology for airspace awareness and safety. The Embedded Software Engineer develops high-performance embedded sensor software for counter-unmanned aircraft systems and unmanned aircraft traffic management, including target detection and tracking, data processing, system health monitoring, and network interactions.

Responsibilities
Contribute to the development of software components that advance our sensor’s ability to:
Detect and track new types of targets
Process target data with high throughput and reliable performance
Monitor performance and health metrics and autonomously recover from faults
Interact with cloud-based systems and other network components
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, architect solutions, and implement features
Develop performant software and improve the existing codebase as an individual contributor
Participate in collaborative design and code reviews
Document and clearly communicate designs to peers
Test and validate implementations to ensure proper and bug free operation
